BBTC HAS THE MOVES
The real origin story

It started on a job site.

A few job-site fellas. One stupid joke. Way too much laughter.

Some fellas on the job site got to laughing about the same ridiculous thing: the balls were way too big and the cock was way too small. The whole thing looked like it was just perched up there.

It was such a dumb visual that nobody could stop laughing. Instead of letting the joke die at the job site, it turned into BBTC — Big Balls, Tiny Cock.

Now the joke has a face: that cocky grin, those purple shorts, and a stick-figure menace who dances straight through the chaos he causes.

No grand origin myth. Just a joke that kept getting funnier.
